title: PhD Stipend in Intelligent Industrial Energy Systems, Physics-informed AI, digital twins and advanced control
description:
Help build the systems that will electrify industry
Industrial energy systems are about to change fundamentally. For more than a century, industrial processes have been designed as isolated, deterministic systems. You model them, you optimize them, you operate them. That paradigm is breaking down. As electricity replaces fossil fuels, industrial systems must operate under fundamentally new conditions: fluctuating renewable energy, dynamic electricity prices, and increasing system complexity.

In the future, industrial energy systems will not simply run.

  • They will understand themselves.
  • They will learn from data.
  • They will anticipate and adapt.
  • They will optimize continuously.

At Aalborg University, we are starting to build the scientific foundations for those systems. We are looking for a PhD researcher who wants to be part of that.

The stipend is open for appointment from 15 September 2026 or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

What this PhD is really about
This PhD focuses on modelling and controlling electrified industrial thermal systems under real-world conditions. The work is embedded in a collaborative research project with industrial partners, providing access to realistic system configurations, experimental setups and operational data. The scientific ambition is to develop methods that combine physical models and data-driven approaches for adaptive, real-time operation of complex energy systems. Applications such as drying processes serve as test cases, but the goal is to establish methodologies that extend across industrial thermal systems more broadly.

How do we create industrial energy systems that combine physics and data to become adaptive, autonomous and trustworthy?
To get there, you will work at the intersection of thermal energy systems, machine learning and scientific AI, system modelling and identification, as well as optimization and control.

Your work will focus on developing new methods that integrate first-principles models with data-driven learning, supported by reduced-order representations and designed for real-time optimization and control. In essence, this is about physics-informed AI-approaches where physical insight and data reinforce each other rather than compete.

The ambition is to move beyond abstract or idealized solutions. Think digital twins that are not just conceptual, but genuinely useful in practice. Think control systems that can operate robustly under uncertainty, rather than relying on simplified assumptions.

The systems you will be working with are real world, industrial scale energy systems rather than simplified lab set-ups. They include high-temperature, high-power applications, including heat pumps, thermal storage, and complex process units, where both physical understanding and intelligent control are essential.

What you will do
Your day-to-day research will move between theory, modelling and real systems.

  • You will build mathematical and physics-based models of complex thermal systems.
  • You will develop reduced order representations enabling real-time implementation suited for online optimization of operating conditions and control.
  • You will combine the models with data driven learning to adapt to varying operating conditions.
  • You will design control strategies that can operate under real-world constraints.

Some of your work will be purely theoretical. Some of it will be validated against experimental setups and industrial data. You will publish your work, present it internationally, and build a research profile that is relevant far beyond this specific application.

The environment you will step into
You will not be placed inside a narrow, predefined research group. Instead, you will work across a small, complementary team that brings together different pieces of the puzzle:

thermal systems and physical modelling advanced control and system-level thinking industrial electrification and future energy technologies

This is an emerging collaboration, not a finished structure.  This means that you are not just executing a predefined roadmap. You are helping shape the direction.

Your supervisors
You will be supported by a team with different strengths, scientifically and personally.

Henrik Sørensen is Head of Section and your main supervisor. His focus is not only on research, but on building researchers. He will push you, give you space, and expect you to grow into an independent scientist.

Henrik C. Pedersen is Vice Head of Research and one of the key profiles within modelling and control at AAU. He will challenge your thinking, sharpen your methods and connect your work to a broader scientific context.

Anna Lyhne Jensen represents the next generation of energy researchers.
Her work focuses on electrification of industrial processes and future thermal systems, and she is deeply engaged in the green transition. She will be your closest collaborator in many parts of the project.

Together, the team is not uniform, and that is exactly the point. No single discipline can solve this problem.

Who you are
You likely have a background in energy engineering, mechanical engineering, control, applied mathematics, physics or a related field.

But more importantly, we are looking for someone who:

  • Has a strong curiosity about how complex systems actually work.
  • Is comfortable with mathematical modelling and analytical thinking.
  • Is motivated to combine physical insight with data-drive methods.
  • Enjoys building models and methods – not just analyzing existing ones.
  • Has the ambition and persistence to tackle difficult problems and carry them through.

This is a demanding PhD. It requires both independence and engagement, and a willingness to work at the intersection of disciplines. You don’t need to know everything from the start - but you should have a clear drive to develop expertise and contribute at a high scientific level.

What you get out of it
This PhD is not just about writing three papers and moving on. It is about building a profile that sits at the intersection of energy systems, AI & modelling and optimization & control. That combination is rare, and extremely valuable, both in academia and industry.

  • You will work with real systems, real data and real problems.
  • You will collaborate with industry.
  • You will be part of the broader European research landscape in energy and sustainability.

And you will have a high degree of freedom to shape your own direction.

Why this matters
Industrial heat is one of the hardest parts of the green transition. Electrification alone is not enough. If we cannot control and optimize these systems intelligently, we will not unlock their full potential. This PhD is about contributing to these missing pieces.

Expected starting date is 15 September 2026 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Interested?
If you want to work on something that is technically challenging, scientifically interesting, and actually matters — we would like to hear from you. Applications should include a CV, transcripts and a short motivation.

For further information, feel free to contact:

Henrik Sørensen, hs@energy.aau.dk

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at: the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    
AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners and other academic environments to address real‑world energy challenges.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus.
AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and from a broad range of national backgrounds. This creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as the working language in research and teaching, which makes it straightforward for international colleagues to integrate.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday life. New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters.

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk.

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Further information  
Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employment
When pursuing a PhD at Aalborg University, you'll receive a stipend which includes both salary
and pension benefits. The base salary starts at a minimum of 31.242,75 DKK before taxes, with an
additional 18,07% added for pension contributions. However, the final salary can be negotiated
based on your qualifications and experience, with seniority playing a key role in determining the
main salary.
Read more about pension options here.

At Aalborg University's Doctoral School, engineering PhD students enjoy unique career
development opportunities. These include personalized DISC profile assessments with feedback,
career-focused courses, and networking events with trade unions, employers, and other relevant
parties. Learn more about these initiatives at our Career Hub.

The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities (the Appointment Order) and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities (in Danish).

Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) (in Danish) 

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

title: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor DK summer / Spain winther

About the Role

As a Flight Instructor, your primary responsibility will be delivering flight training onboard our aircraft. Depending on operational needs, you may also conduct simulator sessions and classroom-based theoretical instruction.

You will guide students throughout their training journey and help ensure the highest standards of pilot education.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI

  • Set to have a split base between Denmark in the summer and Spain in the winter

  • Based in either DK or Spain

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

  • Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

  • CRI/SPA ME, or

  • IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

  • ME qualification (preferred but not required)

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.

title: Executive Assistant to the Secretary General (maternity cover)
description:
Are you a strategic thinker, structured and with exceptional execution and communication skills? And do you have experience with executive and strategic support to senior management and knowledge of humanitarian and global affairs? We are looking for an experienced, proactive, extrovert and solutions oriented Executive Assistant to the Secretary General of the Danish Refugee Council (DRC). You will support the Secretary General in her daily work, work closely with the DRC Executive Management Team and engage with a variety of internal and external stakeholders.

About the job

The office of the Secretary General is a small dynamic team, supporting the Secretary General, the Executive Management Team, the Board of Directors, and the Council of DRC. The office also supports DRC’s overall organisational processes and its overall strategy, provides management and administrative support to the Secretary General, and organises global staff meetings. The office works and coordinates closely with departments in headquarters as well as DRC offices across the world.

 

Your key responsibilities will include:

·         Day-to-day comprehensive executive support and advice to the Secretary General, including on external engagements, positioning and communication, in close coordination with relevant teams. Liaising and communicating clearly and professionally on behalf of the Secretary General internally in DRC and with external stakeholders.

·         Support to the Executive Management Team (EMT), including preparation of agendas and presentations, decision-making documents and minutes, follow-up to decisions, and preparation of regular bilateral meetings between the SG and EMT members, including agenda setting. 

·         Coordinating and advising on processes for preparing the Secretary General’s external engagements, including drafting and proof reading of products (briefs, talking points, presentations etc.) for the Secretary General, and ensure timely and efficient follow-ups and minutes, and feedback to relevant teams.

·         Making sure that the Secretary General receives information requiring her attention and action and managing the Secretary General’s calendar.

·         Identify opportunities to simplify processes and strengthen ways of working through digital tools, automation and AI-enabled solutions.

·         Ensuring expense management in Microsoft Dynamics, related to SG travels, events and meetings (primary task of student assistant).

·         Ensuring legalisation of documents required across the organisation, including notarisation, apostilles, and coordination with embassies and translation services (primary task of student assistant).

 

About you

To be successful in this role we expect you to have:

·         A relevant master’s degree in international relations, political science or similar.

·         Excellent collaboration, analytical, organisational and communication skills, a flexible and solution-oriented attitude, and a structured and independent way of working with the ability to see the bigger picture while maintaining a strong attention to detail and high-quality deliverables.

·         Ability to maintain overview of a broad operational and political portfolio, advise on priorities and ensure timely execution and follow-up.

·         Solid knowledge of humanitarian affairs and operations, as well as international relations and developments impacting the work of DRC.

·         Experience in interacting with many different stakeholders, including high level, ideally from diplomacy and/or external relations from a global organisation.

·         Ability to deliver high-quality analytical inputs, and to draft complex briefing materials, talking points, and political or legal reports in fast-paced, high-pressure environment is required.

·         Full professional proficiency in Danish and English. Basic knowledge of French and/or Spanish is desirable.

 

All employees should master DRC's core competencies:

Striving for excellence: You focus on reaching results while ensuring an efficient process. 

Collaborating: You involve relevant parties and encourage feedback. 

Taking the lead: You take ownership and initiative while aiming for innovation. 

Communicating: You listen and speak effectively and honestly. 

Demonstrating integrity: You uphold and promote the highest standards of ethical and professional conduct in relation to our values and Code of Conduct, including safeguarding against sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment.

We offer

An interesting workplace with excellent colleagues and plenty of scope for contribution with your own ideas. The possibility of working closely with and supporting the Secretary General and the Executive Management Team, as well as colleagues across our global organisation.

Contract length: 9 months with the possibility of extension (maternity cover)

Work location: Lyngbyvej 100, 2100 Copenhagen Ø, just by Ryparken station

Start date: mid-November 2026 or the soonest hereafter

Salary and conditions will be in accordance with the agreement between DRC and AC. This is a national position for which local terms and conditions apply. Salary will be determined based on qualifications.

Please note that you need to have the right to work in Denmark (through nationality or existing work visa) in order to be considered for this role. 

 

Application process

All applicants must upload a cover letter and an updated CV in English (no longer than four pages) as well as degree certificate. Applications sent by email will not be considered.

Closing date for applications: 2 September 2026. We expect to conduct interviews in September.

Further information 

For questions regarding the vacancy please contact Vibeke Bach Madsen, Corporate Strategic Advisor in the Secretary General’s Office: vibeke.bach.madsen@drc.ngo. We will do our best to respond to as many inquiries as possible.

For more information about the Danish Refugee Council, please visit our website drc.ngo.

Danish Refugee Council is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and positive work environment based on mutual respect for all employees. All applicants are considered for employment regardless of personal characteristics or attributes.

title: Junior Planner
description:
Are you curious about how bestselling fashion products stay available in stores and online around the world? Do you enjoy working with data and finding solutions? If you're looking for a place where you can learn, grow and make an impact from day one, this could be your next step.

Join SELECTED's Essentials department as our new Junior Planner and become part of the team behind one of our most important business areas. Together, we ensure that our bestselling products are available when and where our customers need them, across international markets.

YOUR TEAM
Essentials is home to SELECTED's Never Out Of Stock programme, also known as NOOS. Here, we work to keep our bestselling products available throughout the year by balancing customer demand, inventory and product availability. To make that happen, we work closely with colleagues across Sales, Buying and Product, as well as with our international suppliers. 
You'll join a skilled and supportive team where knowledge is shared openly, responsibility comes early and you'll have plenty of opportunities to learn, develop and make an impact.

YOUR ROLE
As a Junior Planner, you'll help ensure that SELECTED's bestselling products are available throughout the year. By combining data, analysis and close collaboration with colleagues across the business, you'll see how every planning decision helps keep our bestselling products moving.
From day one, you'll contribute to the team's work while developing your analytical skills and commercial understanding. As you grow in the role, you'll gradually take on more responsibility and build your expertise within different planning disciplines. Depending on your development and business needs, you'll have the opportunity to specialise within areas such as demand planning or replenishment planning.

Your tasks will include:

  • Monitoring sales, stock levels and product availability across international markets

  • Analysing data and identifying trends that support planning and business decisions

  • Supporting forecasting, replenishment and purchasing activities

  • Preparing reports and maintaining planning data in our systems

  • Collaborating with colleagues across Sales, Buying and Product to ensure an efficient product flow

  • Contributing ideas that help improve planning processes and commercial performance.

YOUR PROFILE
We believe you'll thrive if you're curious about how a business works, enjoy analysing data and are motivated by turning data into meaningful business decisions. You're eager to learn, enjoy collaborating across teams and are ready to take responsibility while making a real contribution to the business. In addition, we imagine that you:

  • Hold a relevant degree within Supply Chain Management, Business, Economics, Engineering or a similar analytical field

  • Have experience working with Microsoft Excel and are eager to strengthen your analytical toolbox

  • Work in a structured and detail-oriented way

  • Communicate confidently in English, both written and spoken.

WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOU
If you have any questions about the position, please contact Nidal Himidi on +45 52 15 12 83. Otherwise, please send your application and CV as soon as possible and no later than 7 September 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to remove the job advertisement, when we find the right candidate.  

LOCATION: Brande, Denmark.

title: To lønkonsulenter til lønadministrationen i Albertslund Kommune
description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde i en kommune med store ambitioner, engagerede medarbejdere og en samarbejdskultur, der går på tværs af områder og niveauer? Så søger vi to nye kollegaer til vores lønteam, der kan arbejde selvstændigt og lide at have indflydelse på løsningen af egne opgaver, men samtidig er en holdspiller, der brænder for den organisation, du bliver en del af. 

Om Albertslund Kommune

Albertslund er en grøn kommune med store ambitioner. Vi er stolte af vores kommune, og gør os umage i vores opgaver og indsatser for borgerne, foreningerne og virksomhederne. Vi er én kommune og én organisation. Vi har engagerede og dygtige medarbejdere samt en samarbejdskultur, der går på tværs af områder og niveauer. Det gør Albertslund Kommune til et godt sted at arbejde. 

Om enheden HR & Løn i Albertslund Kommune
Lønadministrationen er et nyt team, der pr. 1. januar 2026 blev udvidet til at bestå af 7 lønkonsulenter og en faglig koordinator. Dette skete ifm. en centralisering af lønadministrationen. Pt. er de 5 stillinger som lønkonsulenter besat og stillingen som faglig koordinator, så derfor har vi to ledige stillinger som lønkonsulenter hos os. Formålet med centraliseringen er at skabe en professionel lønfunktion og dermed få en driftssikker og bæredygtig lønfunktion på den lange bane. Udover lønteamet er der et team på 3 medarbejdere og en studentermedhjælper, der arbejder med personalejura og 3 kolleger, som arbejder med arbejdsmiljø, MED og udviklingsopgaver. Vores primære rolle er at yde faglig bistand og rådgivning til hele organisationen, både det politiske og administrative niveau, omkring personalejura, HR og løn. Du bliver en del af et stærkt hold. Ambitionerne og det faglige niveau er højt, stemningen er god og man "vil hinanden". Vi tager alle ansvar for opgaverne og anvender digitale værktøjer så meget som muligt.

Om stillingen
Vi drømmer om at få to nye kollegaer, der har vilje, lyst og evne til at arbejde med lønadministration Det er vigtigt for os, at du er nysgerrig, initiativrig og har eller ønsker at få en bred viden om løn- og ansættelsesvilkår inden for det kommunale område. Det er vigtigt, at du har en opsøgende og struktureret tilgang i dit arbejde. Vi bruger KMD Opus. Du vil komme til at håndtere alle personalegrupper, samt alle typer af ansættelser på tværs af kommunen, ligesom du meget gerne må have talforståelse. Du skal derfor have lyst til og interesse for en hverdag med stor bredde i opgaverne. Er dette ikke muligt fra starten, så arbejder vi os derhen sammen.

Stillingen har fokus på klassisk lønadministration. Opgaverne i denne stilling består primært i lønsagsbehandling af forskellig art, såsom:

  • Generel personaleadministration, udfærdigelse af ansættelsesbrev, anciennitetsberegninger for løn og pension, timetalsændring, lønsammensætning, fratrædelse m.v.
  • Rådgivning og vejledning til ledere, administrative medarbejder, lønmodtager og øvrige samarbejdspartner i relation til alle spørgsmål vedrørende løn, ansættelsesvilkår, arbejdstid, barsel, sygdom, refusion og ferieregler m.m.
  • Lønindplacering
  • Overenskomstfortolkning
  • Ansøgning om og behandling af diverse refusioner (dagpenge, flexjob, barsel og AKUT) 
  • Ændringer i E-indkomst og SKAT
  • Afstemninger af lønkonti
  • Håndtering af spørgsmål til KMD Opus
  • Udarbejdelse af skriftlige oplæg/retningslinjer om lønområdet
  • Arbejde med digitalisering/automatisering af processerne omkring løn

Det vil være en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med lønadministration, men det er ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har mod på og lyst til de beskrevne opgaver. 

Dagene er aldrig ens, men der vil dog være en række tilbagevendende opgaver. 

Vi forventer, at du kan arbejde selvstændigt, og tager ansvar for opgaverne på lige fod med dine kollegaer. Du bliver en del af et team og en enhed, der vægter samarbejdet og relationerne højt, har det sjovt med hinanden, og som vil gøre sig umage for, at du kan føle dig hjemme. Du skal trives med månedlige deadlines, og være god til at kunne prioritere både egne såvel som teamets fælles opgaver, for at alle når i mål.

Vi kan tilbyde

  • et spændende og udfordrende job i en bæredygtig by for børnene, det grønne og fællesskabet
  • nogle fantastiske kollegaer, som venter på at byde dig velkommen og glæder sig til samarbejdet med dig
  • deltagelse i udvidelsen af en lønadministration, der skal professionaliseres
  • stor bredde i opgaverne
  • gode muligheder for at præge jobindholdet og sætte dine kompetencer i spil 
  • fleksibel arbejdstid med mulighed for hjemmearbejdsdage.

Ansøgning og tiltrædelse

Stillingerne er faste på 37 timer på overenskomstvilkår med start 1. november 2026. Lønindplacering sker efter forhandling mellem kommunen og den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.

Det er en del af Albertslund Kommunes ansættelsespolitik at fremme mangfoldighed og ligestilling. 

Det er en forudsætning for din ansættelse i Albertslund Kommune, at du har en gyldig arbejds- og opholdstilladelse. 

Albertslund Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid.

Der er ansøgningsfrist onsdag den 31. august 2026. Der kan indgå en case i en evt. 2. samtale. 

Du kan blive klogere på Albertslund som by og arbejdsplads på www.albertslund.dk

Du er velkommen til at kontakte leder af HR & Løn, Maria Sauer på tlf. 20 49 96 75, eller faglig koordinator for lønadministrationen Elena Høgskær på telefon 60 56 24 09, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Velkommen til Albertslund - den bæredygtige by for børnene, det grønne og fællesskaber. Albertslund Kommune har mange kvaliteter, som skaber fantastiske rammer for hverdagslivet – både for borgere og medarbejdere. Midt i naturen og med et rigt forenings- og kulturliv, som børn og voksne cykler til og fra på byens mange kilometer cykelstier, der er adskilt fra bilerne på vejene. Der er S-tog lige til døren og flere supercykelstier, bl.a. mellem Albertslund og Vesterport i hjertet af København. Desuden skaber letbanen gode forbindelser til hele hovedstadsområdet. 

I Albertslund Kommune har vi samme tilgang til vores opgaver, som vi selv ville ønske at opleve som borgere. Vi er vidt forskellige, men er fælles om vores opgave for borgere, foreninger og virksomheder. Du kan møde nogle af vores dygtige medarbejdere på www.albertslund.dk/indefra og få et indtryk af bredden af arbejdsområder, opgaver og fagligheder i Albertslund Kommune. 

I Albertslund Kommune er der højt til loftet og gode udviklingsmuligheder - vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Project & Business Coordinator
description:
Do you enjoy turning plans into action and bringing structure to complex, cross-functional initiatives?  

Avincis is looking for a Project & Business Coordinator to join our Nordic organisation. This is a broad and highly collaborative role where you will work closely with our Nordic management team and colleagues across Sweden, Norway, Finland and Denmark. 

You will be at the centre of projects, business improvement initiatives and management activities that span functions and countries. From coordinating strategic projects and Management of Change processes to supporting business cases, contracts and performance reporting, you will help ensure that priorities move forward and that decisions are translated into action. 

For the right person, this is an excellent opportunity to gain broad exposure to a complex, international aviation business and work closely with senior management.

Location: Stockholm, Tromsø or Esbjerg

Reports to: Managing Director Nordics

The role

As our Project & Business Coordinator, you will support and coordinate strategic initiatives and cross-functional projects across the Nordic organisation. 

You will bring structure, follow-up and momentum to projects and business activities, while also supporting the Nordic management team with analysis, reporting, contracts and decision-making material. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Coordinating cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives across the Nordics 

  • Developing and maintaining project plans, milestones, budgets, risk registers and progress reporting 

  • Coordinating Management of Change (MOC) processes and ensuring appropriate documentation and follow-up 

  • Supporting the preparation of business cases, investment proposals and cost-saving initiatives 

  • Facilitating project meetings, workshops and steering group meetings and following up agreed actions 

  • Supporting contract administration, negotiations, renewals and amendments 

  • Supporting commercial activities and tender processes 

  • Preparing management reports, presentations and decision-making material 

  • Analysing operational and financial performance and supporting KPI and dashboard reporting 

  • Identifying opportunities to improve, simplify and standardise processes across the Nordic organisation 

  • Supporting strategic planning, organisational development and change initiatives 

  • Acting as a connecting point between management, operational teams and support functions across countries 

Who are we looking for?

We believe you are a structured and proactive person who enjoys working in an environment where priorities can change and where collaboration is essential. 

You are comfortable coordinating several activities at the same time and know how to create clarity and progress without losing sight of the bigger picture. You enjoy working with people across different functions and levels of an organisation and are confident interacting with senior stakeholders. 

You probably have experience from project coordination, project management, business support, business development or a similar role. 

We would also like you to have: 

  • Strong organisational and project management or coordination skills 

  • An understanding of financial analysis and business cases 

  • Good analytical and problem-solving capabilities 

  • Experience or understanding of contract administration and commercial processes 

  • An understanding of risk management and governance 

  • Strong communication skills in English and at least one Nordic language 

  • Experience supporting management teams and senior stakeholders 

  • Experience from aviation or another regulated industry, tender or procurement processes, Management of Change and/or SAP is an advantage, but not a requirement.

What will make you successful? 

You are someone who takes ownership and makes things happen. You enjoy creating structure where there are many moving parts, following up on actions and ensuring that projects continue to move forward. 

At the same time, you are curious about the business behind the projects. You want to understand why we are doing something, not just what needs to be done. 

You are collaborative, pragmatic and comfortable working across different countries, functions and cultures. 

Why join Avincis? 

At Avincis, our work has a clear purpose. We provide critical aviation services across Europe, supporting missions where aviation makes a real difference. 

In this role, you will have the opportunity to work across our Nordic organisation and gain insight into many different parts of the business. You will work closely with Nordic management while collaborating with colleagues in operations, finance, safety, HR, procurement and other functions. 

It is a role with broad exposure, significant variety and the opportunity to influence how we work across the Nordics. 

If you are looking for a role where you can combine projects, business, analysis and collaboration – and where no two days are quite the same – we would love to hear from you. 

Ready to take the next step? Apply and become part of Avincis Nordics.

title: Postdoctoral researcher position on monitoring tools for assessing animal health and welfare at the Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, Aarhus University
employer: Technical Sciences - Institut for Husdyr- og Veter
description:
We are seeking a motivated postdoctoral researcher to join our international team working on monitoring animal health and welfare.

The position is for two years and will commence December 1, 2026, or soon thereafter. The position is within the research section Management and Modelling.

The research section Management and Modelling develop methods and tools for herd management to promote animal welfare, green transition, and economic viability. Further, the section integrates, develops, and disseminates knowledge of farm animal management and relationships between actors and animals. Researchers in the section teach BSc, MSc and PhD in animal and veterinary science educations and conduct research-based public advice for national and international authorities on animal welfare and health.

The research section is a dynamic multidisciplinary research group including animal scientists, veterinarians, economists, statisticians, and anthropologists.

The position

We seek a post doc to evaluate data and monitoring tools for assessing animal health and welfare in all major livestock production systems (cattle, pig and poultry). The post doc will contribute to identification of animal-based indicators for pig welfare to be used in pig welfare inspection. The post doc will also contribute to the development of training materials in targeting pig welfare inspectors in EU member states.

Your profile

We are looking for a candidate who:
  • Holds a PhD or equivalent academic qualifications.
  • Has research experience in monitoring animal welfare, health or production on any of the major livestock production systems (cattle, pigs or poultry).

Research tasks
  • Evaluating data and monitoring tools for assessing animal health and welfare in cattle, pig or poultry
  • Identification of animal-based indicators for pig welfare to be used in screening of pig welfare in relation to inspection
  • Development and evaluation of training and testing programmes targeting European pig welfare inspectors

The preferred candidate will also engage in and further develop ongoing research and teaching within the Management and Modelling group.

What we offer
  • A well-developed research infrastructure, laboratories and access to shared equipment and animal-experimental facilities
  • An informal and multicultural research environment with high professionalism and close collaboration and networking activities
  • A workplace characterized by equality and a good work-life balance, and an open discussion across different fields of research.

Who we are

Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences is well-known for its skilled and very innovative interdisciplinary research environments with high international impact. We perform world-class research, which contributes with solutions to solve essential societal challenges within the green transition: food production and veterinary medicine – nationally and globally.

The department generates novel research at the highest international level within sustainable food production, environment, climate, and health and welfare for animals and humans. The activities form the basis for the research-based public sector consultancy and degree programs covering bachelor’s, master’s and PhD degree programs within animal science and veterinary medicine. We offer a lively, engaged and innovative learning and study environment, which is closely integrated in the research environment.

ANIVET has unique and advanced animal experimental research facilities and technologies, situated in close connection to the research environment, and a comprehensive national and international research network and good industrial and professional collaboration.

Please refer to Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences (au.dk) for further
information about the department; https://anivet.au.dk/en

Contact

Further information on the position may be obtained from Head of Research Unit, Professor Jan Tind Sørensen, phone: +4520783343, email: jantind.sorensen@anivet.au.dk.

Living in Denmark

Please visit the international staff website: https://internationalstaff.au.dk/prearrival/ for information about arriving to and living in Denmark for both the applicants and their potential family.

Place of employment and place of work

The place of work is the Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, AU Viborg, Blichers Allé 20, DK-8830 Tjele, and the area of employment is Aarhus University (AU) with related departments.


Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self.


Formalities and salary range
Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

title: 1.assistent til rengøringsteam SMP - Aalborg og omegn
description:

Er du serviceminded og kan lide et job med meget kørsel?

SMP er i rivende udvikling og søger derfor en erfaren medarbejder på fuldtid (37t), til vores i forvejen stærke team i Aalborg og omegn.

Som 1.assistent er dit ansvar at sikre afviklingen af den daglige rengøring i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør.

Andre opgaver kan også forekomme.

Du vil have direkte reference til din Serviceinspektør hos SMP. Jobbet indebærer b.la. følgende arbejdsområder:

•   Skal stå for rengøring af egne pladser og øvrig bemanding iht. rengøringskalenderen

•   Skabe god relation til kunderne

•   Være behjælpelig med afløsning ved. ferie/sygdom

•   Hjælpe ved opstart af nye kunder og opgaver sammen med Serviceinspektør

•   Forefaldne opgaver i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør

 

Det skal forventes, at timer kan ligge både tidlig morgen, eftermiddag og aften.

 

Hvem er du?

 

Vi søger dig, som trives i en omskiftelig hverdag, hvor opgaverne og dagene aldrig er ens.

Det er ikke vigtigt for dig, at du har faste rammer mandag-fredag fra 8-16, men tværtimod trives du med en flydende hverdag, hvor arbejdsugen kan variere med forskellige tidspunkter på dagen.

Som person kan du nikke genkendende til, at du:

•   Har erfaring med erhvervsrengøring

•   Trives i en til tider hektisk hverdag

•   Står til rådighed for rengøring af egne pladser

•   deler telefonvagt efter forudgående aftale

     står for sidemandsoplæring af rengøringspersonale

•   Er humoristisk anlagt og kan håndtere og omgås forskellige kulturer

•   Behersker dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale på et rimeligt niveau

•   Har kørekort

•   Kan fremvise straffeattest

Du får stillet en firmabil til rådighed, samt firmatelefon- iPad, og arbejdsbeklædning.

Vi glæder os meget til at lære dig at kende - så hvis du kan se dig selv i denne stilling, bedes du sende din ansøgning til: job@smpservice.dk  - husk at mærke ansøgningen ” 1.assistent Aalborg”

 

Samtaler bliver holdt løbende.

 

Har du ikke hørt fra os inden den 01.09.2026, skal du betragte jobbet som besat til anden side.

 

SMP - Facility Service for hele Danmark

Vores kernekompetence er erhvervsrengøring og serviceydelser. Uanset opgavens omfang sikrer vi effektiv og pålidelig service i hele landet

Vi beskæftiger i dag mere end 300 medarbejdere med kunder i en stor del af Danmark. Vi har landsdækkende og lokale aftaler inden for kontor, produktion, skoler, slagterier, bagerier, butikker, supermarkeder mv.

 

SMP har lokale afdelinger både på Fyn, Jylland og Sjælland

title: Junior Embedded Software / Payload Engineer
description:
Want to work within sustainability and drones? Looking to be part of an innovative, fast-growing Danish greentech company with global reach? Then Explicit might be the place for you. 

Our tech team is looking for a new colleague to help build and improve the electronics that turn our drones into precision measuring instruments. If you enjoy hands-on hardware work in a greentech environment and want real ownership over what you build, we want to hear from you. 

About the job 

You will be part of a small, talented tech team, responsible for designing, building and maintaining our fleet of custom UAV deployed across the world to help map critical emissions. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Developing payload firmware that communicates with our drone systems (MAVLink / DJI) and onboard gas instrumentation and other sensors. 

  • Helping to bring new sensor instruments from datasheet to bench to flight. 

  • Improving and fixing existing payloads, diagnose issues on the bench and through in-flight data, harden the firmware, and ship the fix. 

  • Building small interface and breakout PCBs in KiCad, from assembly and bringing it up through to your own revisions. 

  • Potential for CAD and other mechanical work, depending on your qualifications. 

About you 

  • A bachelor's degree or similar/higher in electronics, robotics, computer engineering, mechatronics, physics or similar. 

  • 1+ years of hands-on experience, from your studies, a project, or a job. 

  • Tinker with Arduino/Raspberry Pi type projects. 

  • Wired up and used Serial/UART, I²C, SPI, etc., not just read about them. 

  • Basic C/C++ (or Arduino) and a bit of Python. 

  • English at a professional level. 

Nice to have 

  • Curiosity about drones, sensors and physical measurements. 

  • PCB design/KiCad experience, with signal/noise integrity knowledge. 

  • CAD and/or mechanical knowledge. 

  • Python for log analysis and quick tooling. 

  • Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement. 

What we offer 

  • A permanent, full-time position in a fast-growing greentech company with real-world impact. 

  • Competitive benefits including paid pension, health insurance, parental leave and 6 weeks' holiday allowance. 

  • Real hardware ownership early on, with a senior engineer to learn from. 

  • A flat hierarchy where ideas are heard, initiative is encouraged, and responsibility comes early. 

  • A close-knit, supportive team that values collaboration, trust and learning. 

  • Work that measurably cuts industrial emissions. 

About Explicit 

Explicit ApS is a pioneering Danish engineering company specialising in drone-based emissions monitoring across the energy, maritime, waste management, and other industry sectors. We deliver reliable, transparent and actionable emissions data to some of the largest energy companies all over the world using our patented drone-based methodology. Every measurement depends on the payload the drone carries: the boards, firmware, and sensors. 

We are headquartered in Virum, Denmark, with offices in Norway, Germany and Australia. Our international team of around 30 colleagues brings together engineering, data and environmental expertise, united by a shared mission to make a difference in emissions monitoring. 

Practical information

title: Har du erfaring med autisme, angst og PTSD – og motiveres du af at skabe udvikling gennem en stabil, tillidsfuld og fagligt funderet relation?
description:
Vi søger medarbejdere til en længerevarende § 85-indsats omkring en ung mand i Aarhus. 
Målet er at etablere et lille, fast team, som kan skabe kontinuitet, genkendelighed og tryghed omkring borgeren.

Om indsatsen

Borgeren har autisme, angst og svær PTSD og har behov for struktureret og forudsigelig støtte i hverdagen.

Han kan opleve svære angstanfald, som i perioder påvirker hans evne til at handle og gennemføre almindelige hverdagsaktiviteter. En central del af opgaven er derfor at kunne bevare roen, skabe tryghed og støtte ham i at udvikle og anvende mestringsstrategier, når angsten fylder.

Samtidig er han selv motiveret for udvikling og progression. Der er derfor gode muligheder for at arbejde målrettet med små, men betydningsfulde skridt mod større mestring og selvstændighed.

Hvad skal du arbejde med?

Den socialpædagogiske støtte har blandt andet fokus på:

  • mestringsstrategier i forbindelse med angst og angstanfald
  • støtte til at finde ro og genvinde handlekraft i belastende situationer
  • struktur og opretholdelse af en stabil døgnrytme
  • støtte til hensigtsmæssige rutiner omkring søvn
  • social færdighedstræning
  • gradvis træning i at færdes uden for hjemmet, eksempelvis gennem gåture
  • støtte til aktiviteter uden for hjemmet og øget selvstændighed i hverdagen.

Opgaven kræver, at du kan arbejde roligt, tålmodigt og relationsorienteret. Du skal kunne møde borgeren dér, hvor han er, uden at forcere processen – samtidig med at du har blik for hans ressourcer, motivation og muligheder for progression.

 

Du bliver en del af et fast team

Kontinuitet er en vigtig del af indsatsen. Derfor søger vi medarbejdere, som ønsker at blive en del af et lille og fast team omkring borgeren.

Teamet skal så vidt muligt være selvdækkende og sammen skabe den stabilitet og genkendelighed, som borgeren har behov for.

I teamet deler I faglige perspektiver, metoder, observationer og erfaringer, så der skabes en fælles og sammenhængende tilgang til indsatsen. Der afholdes desuden løbende teammøder med mulighed for faglig sparring og koordinering.

 

Arbejdstider

Indsatsen leveres på faste tidspunkter:

Mandag: kl. 8.00-11.00 og kl. 21.00-23.00

Tirsdag: kl. 8.00-12.00 og kl. 21.00-23.00

Onsdag: kl. 8.00-11.00 og kl. 21.00-23.00

Torsdag: kl. 8.00-12.00 og kl. 21.00-23.00

Fredag: kl. 8.00-11.00 og kl. 21.00-23.00

Søndag: kl. 21.00-23.00

 

Fra 1. september øges dagvagterne til fire timer og placeres kl. 8.00-12.00 eller kl. 9.00-13.00.

Vagttidspunkterne ligger fast og kan ikke flyttes.

Du behøver ikke kunne dække alle vagterne. Vi hører også gerne fra dig, hvis du kan varetage én eller flere faste vagter og dermed indgå stabilt i teamet.

 

Hvem søger vi?

Vi søger dig, som har de faglige og personlige kompetencer til at arbejde med en borger med autisme, angst og svær PTSD.

Det er en klar fordel, hvis du har erfaring med et eller flere af områderne og eksempelvis har en social-, pædagogisk- eller sundhedsfaglig baggrund.

Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du:

  • kan skabe ro, tryghed og forudsigelighed
  • kan bevare ro og overblik, når angsten fylder
  • arbejder respektfuldt og relationsorienteret
  • forstår betydningen af struktur og kontinuitet
  • kan arbejde udviklingsorienteret med respekt for borgerens tempo
  • er stabil og kan forpligte dig på faste vagter
  • bidrager aktivt til faglig sparring og et tæt teamsamarbejde.

Af hensyn til borgerens konkrete behov kan indsatsen udelukkende varetages af kvindelige medarbejdere.

Der er aktuelt ingen fastsat slutdato på indsatsen, og vi søger derfor medarbejdere, som har mulighed for at skabe kontinuitet over tid.

 

Kan du se dig selv i opgaven?

Hvis du har erfaring med autisme, angst og/eller PTSD og trives i et tæt relationsarbejde, hvor udvikling sker gennem tryghed, struktur og vedholdenhed, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Ved interesse får du naturligvis yderligere information om borgeren, støttebehovet og de faglige rammer som en del af den videre rekrutteringsproces.

 

Vi tilbyder dig

  • Teammøder, supervision og konflikthåndteringskurser
  • Faglig udvikling og sparring med kolleger
  • Attraktiv løn iflg. overenskomst

 

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og dit CV samt dine uddannelsesbeviser ved at klikke "Søg Stillingen" længere nede på siden.

title: Senior Automation Manager, Nørresundby, Denmark
description:
Are you our new Automation Manager with a passion for technology, leadership, and scalable automation solutions?

At DESMI, you will play a key role in strengthening and scaling our automation capabilities across the organization. You will be part of product development & innovation leading a skilled engineering team in Denmark and China to develop reliable and future-proof automation solutions for both products and customized needs.
Working closely with Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, you will ensure strong alignment between technical solutions and business requirements. You will be responsible for setting direction, creating structure across projects, and ensuring high quality delivery of automation solutions across DESMI's global operations.
DESMI is a dynamic and innovative company where collaboration, continuous learning, and professional development are at the core of our culture. In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence the direction of our automation landscape, develop your team, and contribute to building scalable and efficient solutions that support our continued growth.

Ideally, we are looking for someone who is:
Technically grounded
Possess strong leadership and people management skills
Structured and organized

A glimpse into the role
You will lead a team of automation engineers while ensuring that our solutions are robust and aligned with business needs. Your primary responsibilities will include:
-Team Leadership & Development: Lead, motivate, and develop a high-performing automation team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
-Project Execution & Prioritization: Plan, structure, and drive execution across multiple automation projects, ensuring clear priorities, efficient resource allocation, and on-time delivery.
-Technical Direction & Quality Assurance: Set the technical direction for automation solutions across hardware and software, ensuring reliable, serviceable, and future-proof designs.
-Operational Ownership of Automation Solutions: Oversee the development and maintenance of automation systems, translating business and product requirements into standardized, scalable technical solutions.
-Stakeholder Management: Act as the key point of contact for stakeholders across Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, ensuring alignment and clear communication on scope, expectations, and deliverables.
-Process & Solution Optimization: Drive structured and transparent workflows across projects, continuously improving processes and enabling efficient and consistent delivery of automation solutions.
-Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Support the ongoing development of DESMI's automation portfolio by promoting a solution-oriented mindset and identifying opportunities for innovation and standardization.

Your next opportunity starts here
We're looking for an experienced and driven leader with a strong technical foundation in automation and a passion for developing both people and solutions. You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and are motivated by creating structure, driving progress, and delivering high-quality results together with your team.

We also imagine that you:
Have minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing technical teams
Bring a strong technical background within automation, electrical engineering, or a similar field, combined with hands-on experience in both hardware and software design
Are structured and capable of creating clarity and overview in complex project environments with multiple ongoing activities
Have strong planning and resource management skills, enabling you to prioritize effectively and ensure successful project execution
Communicate clearly and proactively with stakeholders across functions and organizational levels
Take a solution-oriented approach and are comfortable setting direction while supporting your team in delivering robust and scalable solutions
Have experience working in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift, and where adaptability is key to success
Are fluent in English, as it is DESMI's corporate language

The perks of being at DESMI
Flexible working hours - including possibilities for remote work.
Global career prospects - work with colleagues across Europe, Asia, and the U.S.
Skills development and career growth - Training, job rotation, and internal mobility
Pension - attractive employer contributions
Private healthcare and life insurance
On-site canteen - light breakfast, lunch buffet, and snacks
Company sports & social activities - from badminton and bowling to art clubs and summer parties

What we're about
But we're more than just pumps. At DESMI, we believe teamwork and innovation drive success.
When you join DESMI, you can expect:
A collaborative and supportive team environment.
Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.
A chance to contribute your ideas and make a real impact.
A company that values sustainability and innovation.

We are a flat organization with an open-door policy, where decisions are made together, and ideas are always welcome. Here, doers thrive - if you see an opportunity for improvement, you have the freedom to act on it.
As innovators in reliable and sustainable flow solutions, we serve a wide range of industries from Aquaculture and Defense to Green Technologies - the list goes on. Sustainability is highly appreciated while developing high-performance and long-lasting technologies that help industries adapt to evolving markets while reducing environmental impact.

Ready to apply?
If you're a dedicated and motivated individual seeking a challenging and rewarding career where you can contribute to a more sustainable future, we encourage you to apply!

To learn more about this please contact Søren Flummer (SORF@desmi.com). We are reviewing applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Are you an Authorised Veterinary Nurse with strong anaesthesia and surgical nursing experience?

MyPeterinarian is looking for an experienced Veterinary Nurse to join our Copenhagen team in a part-time role with a strong focus on anaesthesia, surgical nursing and high-quality patient care.

Founded in 2017, MyPeterinarian is an established independent veterinary clinic, grooming salon and pet-sitting company. We are a close-knit team focused on excellent patient care, strong client relationships and creating a positive working environment.

About the Role

The core responsibility of this role is independently managing anaesthesia monitoring - from patient preparation and induction through to recovery. You will play an important role in ensuring safe, calm and well-managed surgical procedures while working closely with the veterinary team.

This role is ideal for a nurse who enjoys surgical nursing, values careful patient monitoring and is confident taking responsibility within their area of expertise.

Please note: MyPeterinarian is planning to relocate to a new Copenhagen location between now and the end of September 2026 -the exact address will be shared during the interview process 

Schedule

Approximately 21 hours per week

  • Tuesday and Wednesday: 09:00-15:00

  • Monday, Thursday and Friday: 10:00-13:00

  • Exact schedule to be agreed with the successful candidate

This is a weekday-only position, with no evenings, weekends or night shifts scheduled as standard, supporting a healthy work-life balance.

Expected start date: 15 September 2026

Key Responsibilities

  • Independently monitoring anaesthesia, including induction and recovery

  • Preparing patients for surgery and providing surgical assistance

  • Supporting blood sample collection and other clinical procedures

  • Providing routine patient care, including nail clipping

  • Handling and supporting patients throughout their visit

  • Maintaining clinical hygiene standards and sterilising equipment

  • Supporting reception and administrative tasks when required

  • Assisting with stock checks and inventory management

Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

  • Is an Authorised Veterinary Nurse

  • Has proven experience of independently monitoring anaesthesia

  • Is comfortable working independently during surgical procedures

  • Has excellent patient handling skills and a calm, professional approach

  • Has a good standard of spoken and written English (Danish is an advantage but not essential)

  • Enjoys being part of a small, collaborative team

What We Offer

  • A friendly and professional team environment

  • A varied clinical role with genuine responsibility

  • No evenings, weekends or night shifts scheduled as standard 

  • Salary: 200dkk/hr

  • Regular team gatherings and a supportive workplace culture

  • Opportunity to increase working hours over time, by mutual agreement

  • Staff discounts on MyPeterinarian veterinary, grooming and pet-sitting services for your own pets

title: Electrical Technician; Location: DK - Esbjerg
description:
Are you passionate about hands-on electrical work in the offshore and maritime industry? Do you thrive on a diverse range of tasks and enjoy travelling as part of your job? If so, this exciting opportunity could be perfect for you!

Your Position
In our Rig & Marine division, we are seeking an Electrical Technician who takes pride in quality craftsmanship and in getting the job done safely. This role offers numerous intriguing challenges, including yard stays and modification projects that contribute to the green transition within drilling rigs and special vessels. Depending on your experience, you may also act as Working Supervisor /
Foreman on selected projects, leading a small team of electricians and cable pullers.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

You will join a team of 5 colleagues working both locally and globally on projects within our division. The Rig & Marine division is comprised of 450 colleagues worldwide. This full-time position is based at our headquarters in Esbjerg, Denmark. You should expect between 100-150 travel days per year, with occasional work at our yard or locally in Esbjerg.

“I'm looking for an Electrical Technician who takes pride in the craft. This job is hands-on – pulling cables, terminating, testing and troubleshooting on rigs and special vessels around the world – always with safety first. If you enjoy varied work and being part of a tight-knit team – and perhaps have the ambition to step up as Working Supervisor on our projects – we'd love to hear from you.” - Manager, Electrical Engineering, Frederik Vester Pedersen

Your tasks and responsibilities
You will carry out electrical installation and maintenance work on our projects and report progress to your Supervisor or Project Manager. Quality, safety, and good order in tools and materials are essential in this role.
  • Perform electrical installation work such as cable pulling, glanding, termination, and mounting of equipment according to drawings and specifications.
  • Carry out testing, troubleshooting, and commissioning support on electrical systems on drilling rigs and special vessels.
  • Work in accordance with the permit-to-work system and all HSE rules and regulations, contributing to a strong safety culture on site.
  • Register your hours daily and help keep track of materials, tools, and equipment.
  • Cooperate with colleagues and other contractors on site and report progress and any deviations to your Supervisor.

title: Postdoc in clinical Raman spectroscopy and AI-based diagnostics
description:
A position as Postdoc (full-time) is vacant at the TE Andersen Lab part of the Research Unit of Clinical Microbiology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Shape the future of clinical diagnostics

We are seeking an ambitious and highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to help establish next-generation Raman spectroscopy technologies for clinical microbiology. This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the interface between optics, artificial intelligence, microbiology and clinical diagnostics in close collaboration with hospitals, industry and international research partners.

Research environment

The successful candidate will join the research group led by Professor Thomas Emil Andersen. The group conducts translational research in microbiology, advanced infection models, spectroscopy and medical technology. We collaborate extensively with Danish and international hospitals, universities and industrial partners, with a strong focus on translating innovative technologies into improved patient care.

The academic position

The job involves research, professional development, research education, research-based teaching, and supervision.

Your responsibilities will consist of the following:

  • Lead OUH contributions to the EU- and state-funded projects (Innovation Fund Denmark project nanoRaman, two Eurostars projects MbCare and QMIC, and the MedTech Odense project UriNix).

  • Design, plan and execute experimental studies from concept to publication.

  • Develop Raman spectroscopy workflows for analysis of clinical samples.

  • Apply machine learning and AI for spectral analysis and diagnostic classification.

  • Coordinate collaborations across hospitals, academia and industrial partners.

  • Build and develop a Raman spectroscopy research platform within the Andersen Lab.

  • Supervise students and junior researchers.

  • Publishing results in leading international journals and contributing to future grant applications.

Expectations and qualifications

We are looking for candidates holding a PhD in physics, engineering, optics, spectroscopy, biomedical engineering or a related discipline. The candidate may also hold a PhD within health sciences, biology, microbiology or similar but should then also hold significant knowledge and experience within optical sciences, spectroscopy and related data handling.

Essential qualifications:

  • Significant knowledge and experience with Raman spectroscopy.

  • Experience with optical instrumentation.

  • Experience with machine learning and/or AI.

  • Experience analysing biological or clinical samples.

  • Profound in scientific writing and a solid publication record.

Desirable qualifications:

  • Experience with clinical microbiology or hospital diagnostics.

  • Experience in academia–industry collaborations.

  • Project coordination skills.

  • Ability to work independently while thriving in multidisciplinary teams.

What we offer

  • A unique translational research environment combining engineering and medicine.

  • Participation in major externally funded collaborative projects.

  • Close interaction with clinicians, engineers and industrial partners.

  • Access to state-of-the-art spectroscopy and microbiology facilities.

  • Excellent opportunities for scientific publishing, networking and career development.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision - We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future - it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research - with people at the centre; strong research environments - as drivers of development; and the research journey - from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information

Further information about the position can be obtained from Professor Thomas Emil Andersen, e-mail: thandersen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 21261634 or Head of Department of Clinical Research, Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 65503477.

Application deadline

August 18, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at the laboratory of Professor Andersen at the Department of Clinical Microbiology, Odense University Hospital, J. B. Winsløws Vej 21.1, Odense C, Denmark. The laboratory and department will move to the newly built University Hospital associated with the University of Southern Denmark, in late summer 2027.  

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a research plan detailing the candidate’s ideas and plans for her/his future research work

  • An explanation other qualification relevant to the post

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

Du prägst die KI‑Ausrichtung der DLG und leitest ein Team, das wirkungsvolle, geschäftsorientierte Lösungen liefert. Konkret bedeutet das:

Du bist eine erfahrene **Führungskraft (m/w/d)** mit einer starken technischen Basis und einer Leidenschaft dafür, sowohl Menschen als auch Lösungen weiterzuentwickeln. - nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Führung und Entwicklung von Teams im Bereich KI, Daten oder Advanced Analytics mitbringen
- ein tiefes Verständnis für Solution Architecture und komplexe IT‑Landschaften haben
- Erfahrung darin haben, KI‑ oder Dateninitiativen von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung zu treiben
- in der Lage sein, geschäftliche Prioritäten mit technologischen Möglichkeiten zu verbinden
- Erfahrung mit Governance, Priorisierung und funktionsübergreifenden Entscheidungen haben
- eine starke Führungspersönlichkeit sein, die motiviert, coacht und Engagement schafft
- strukturiert und ergebnisorientiert arbeiten
- klar kommunizieren und komplexe Themen verständlich machen
- sicher in Deutsch und Englisch kommunizieren

Unser Angebot

Bei DLG erwartet dich eine spannende und wirkungsvolle Rolle in einem Unternehmen, in dem KI und Digitalisierung ganz oben auf der Agenda stehen.

- eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gestaltung der KI‑Ausrichtung eines internationalen Unternehmens
